These two drugs are known to modulate the activity of the Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3, suggesting a possible pathway where the glucuronic acid compound may act as a modulator of this transporter. The final scores from the paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though the exact mechanism of interaction remains to be elucidated. The evidence supports a potential role for this compound in influencing the function of the transporter, but further experimental validation is required to confirm the direct interaction and its biological relevance.
